shortDescription: Mexico said its troops were sent to a border area in Texas in conjunction with the US as part of “mirror operations,” according to Bloomberg.The Mexican government said Saturday that the deployment was joint.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Mexico Says Troops Deployed to Texas Border With US
